title: Associate Consultant – Adult Cardiology
summary: Provide comprehensive specialist care to adult patients with cardiovascular conditions, from diagnosis through follow-up.
responsibilities: Diagnose and treat adult cardiovascular conditions
Supervise medical officers, interns and trainees
Prepare departmental workplans, budgets and reports
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Medicine (Internal Medicine) or equivalent
Fellowship or Masters in Cardiology
Registered with UMDPC with a valid practising licence
At least 3 years at Medical Officer level

title: Medical Officer
summary: Participate in the management of adult cardiovascular patients, with a fellowship pathway in cardiology during service.
responsibilities: Receive, clerk, admit and discharge patients
Develop patient treatment plans and carry out investigations
Supervise medical interns and trainees
requirements: MBChB and an MSc in Medicine (Internal Medicine) or equivalent
Registered with UMDPC with a valid practising licence

title: Associate Consultant – Paediatric Cardiology
summary: Provide specialist care for children with cardiovascular conditions, from accurate diagnosis through ongoing follow-up.
responsibilities: Diagnose and treat paediatric cardiovascular conditions
Train health professionals in paediatric cardiology
Supervise medical officers, interns and trainees
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Medicine in Paediatrics and Child Health or equivalent
Fellowship or Masters in Paediatric Cardiology
At least 3 years at Medical Officer level

title: Associate Consultant – Adult Cardiovascular Surgery
summary: Provide specialist surgical care for adults needing cardiovascular intervention, from assessment through postoperative follow-up.
responsibilities: Diagnose conditions and conduct cardiovascular surgeries
Supervise medical officers, interns and trainees
Evaluate subordinates and identify growth opportunities
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Science in Surgery or equivalent
Completed fellowship in cardiovascular surgery
Registered with UMDPC with a valid practising licence
At least 3 years at Medical Officer level

title: Associate Consultant – Paediatric Cardiac Surgery
summary: Diagnose and manage paediatric patients requiring cardiac surgery, aiming for timely treatment and good outcomes.
responsibilities: Diagnose and treat paediatric cardiovascular conditions and conduct surgeries
Supervise medical officers, interns and trainees
Plan equipment and drug procurement for the department
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Medicine in General Surgery or equivalent
Fellowship in cardiovascular surgery
Registered with UMDPC with a valid practising licence
At least 3 years as a Medical Officer

title: Associate Consultant – Cardiac Critical Care
summary: Provide specialist care for cardiac critical care patients and lead training, research and clinical standards in the unit.
responsibilities: Diagnose and manage cardiac conditions and complications
Plan and conduct operational research
Supervise and train medical officers and other health professionals
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Medicine (Anaesthesia, Surgery or Internal Medicine) or equivalent
Fellowship in cardiac intensive care (at least two years)
Interest in research
At least 3 years as a General Practitioner

title: Associate Consultant – Cardiac Anaesthesia
summary: Provide perioperative anaesthetic care for patients undergoing cardiac procedures, from preoperative assessment to postoperative care.
responsibilities: Manage intraoperative anaesthesia and postoperative care
Conduct ward rounds and supervise medical officers and interns
Plan equipment and drug needs for the department
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Medicine in Anaesthesia or equivalent
Fellowship or equivalent in cardiac anaesthesia
Registered with UMDPC with a valid practising licence
At least 3 years as a General Anaesthesiologist

title: Associate Consultant – Radiologist
summary: Interpret and report diagnostic imaging, focused on cardiovascular conditions, to support diagnosis and treatment planning.
responsibilities: Interpret and report imaging studies
Lead case discussions and train intern doctors
Plan and conduct operational research
requirements: MBChB and a Master of Science in Radiology or equivalent
Registered with UMDPC with a valid practising licence
Research evidence is an advantage
Served as a Medical Officer for at least 3 years

title: Radiographer
summary: Perform radiographic examinations to established clinical protocols, delivering safe and accurate diagnostic imaging.
responsibilities: Receive patients and prepare X-ray equipment
Take X-ray images and prepare reports for the doctor or clinical officer
Maintain X-ray equipment
requirements: Diploma in Medical Radiology from a recognised institution
Registered with the Allied Health Professionals Council

title: Medical Laboratory Technician
summary: Run laboratory investigations and produce accurate, timely results to support diagnosis and treatment.
responsibilities: Perform laboratory investigations and submit reports
Carry out phlebotomy at the OPD and wards
Maintain laboratory equipment and inventory
requirements: Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent
Certificate of Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)
Registered with the Allied Health Professionals Council
At least 1 year in a reputable healthcare facility

title: Senior Medical Research Officer
summary: Manage research commissioning and grant processes, keep research documentation accurate, and monitor adherence to clinical research standards.
responsibilities: Support design, delivery and management of research commissions
Develop timelines and monitor progress and budgets
Manage data on organisation-wide systems
requirements: MBChB or equivalent
Master's degree in a health science discipline
A relevant fellowship is an advantage
At least 6 years in clinical research management

title: Epidemiologist
summary: Investigate and analyse cardiac-related diseases and epidemics to support surveillance, detection and prevention.
responsibilities: Conduct investigations and respond to disease outbreaks
Perform statistical analyses and disseminate findings
Design and implement surveillance systems
requirements: MBChB or a Degree in Epidemiology or related field
Master's degree in epidemiology is an advantage
Two years of epidemiology experience in a public health organisation at national level or a multinational

title: Nursing Officer
summary: Provide safe, patient-centred cardiac nursing care, covering assessment, monitoring, treatment, education and continuity of care.
responsibilities: Ensure quality nursing care through nursing protocols
Allocate duties and supervise nursing staff and students
Conduct performance appraisal of staff
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Nursing from a recognised university
Registered with the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council
Valid practising licence

title: Cardiac Critical Care Orderly
summary: Support cardiac patients under nursing and medical supervision, with mobility, hygiene, transport and a clean care environment.
responsibilities: Transport patients and samples for investigations
Maintain sterility and clean instruments
Keep wards and units in order
requirements: O-Level certificate
Training in a health-related course is an advantage

title: Theatre Attendant
summary: Prepare and maintain sterile operating rooms, equipment and supplies, and support patients before and after surgery.
responsibilities: Set up operating rooms and maintain sterility
Coordinate instrument flow with CSSD
Maintain equipment, inventory and records
requirements: O-Level certificate (UCE)
Certificate in a relevant health field

title: Senior Cardiac Public Health Officer
summary: Plan and run cardiac public health programmes, covering prevention, awareness and evaluation of programme performance.
responsibilities: Plan and implement cardiac health promotion and prevention programmes
Collect and analyse data to improve programmes
Prepare quarterly and annual programme reports
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Medicine, Public Health, Nursing Science, Physiotherapy, Nutrition or related field
Master's degree in Public Health or related field
At least 3 years as a Cardiac Public Health Officer

title: Nutritionist (Dietician)
summary: Assess patients' nutritional needs against their medical conditions and medication, and advise on diet for cardiac care and prevention.
responsibilities: Evaluate nutritional needs and adjust dietary plans
Screen and assess patients for nutritional risk
Run outreach sessions on nutrition and CVD prevention
requirements: BSc in Human Nutrition and Dietetics, Clinical Nutrition, Food Science and Nutrition, or related field, or a bachelor's in Food Science and Technology
One year of experience in a hospital or healthcare setting

title: Senior Assistant Secretary
summary: Provide day-to-day administrative services and support the implementation of government policies across the Institute.
responsibilities: Take minutes and provide administrative support
Manage protocol affairs and national functions
Maintain assets, facilities and utilities
requirements: Honours bachelor's degree in a relevant social science, management, law or commerce field
Administrative Officer's Law Course Certificate
Postgraduate diploma in Public Administration, Management or related field
At least 3 years at Assistant Secretary level or equivalent

title: Senior Personal Secretary
summary: Give high-level secretarial and office management support to the Chief Executive, handling sensitive matters with discretion.
responsibilities: Draw up and monitor appointments and programmes
Organise meetings, take minutes and convey decisions
Manage records and supervise support staff
requirements: Honours bachelor's degree in Secretarial Studies or equivalent
At least 3 years as a Personal Secretary in government or a reputable organisation

title: Internal Auditor
summary: Carry out routine internal audits against regulations, checking payments, records and reconciliations.
responsibilities: Check payment requests and match invoices to purchase orders
Prepare bank and financial statement reconciliations
Verify payroll computations and deductions
requirements: Honours bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting, or with a Accountancy or Audit option
Full professional qualification in Accountancy or Audit accredited by ICPAU

title: Laundry Officer
summary: Coordinate laundry services for the Institute, keeping linen supplied and laundry practices up to standard.
responsibilities: Supervise laundry workflow and plan activities
Take part in procurement of laundry consumables
Train laundry staff and maintain laundry registers
requirements: Bachelor's degree in any humanities field
Certificate in laundry practice or infection control
Hospital experience is an advantage

title: Assistant Inventory Management Officer
summary: Receive, store and issue medical supplies and equipment, keeping accurate records and timely distribution.
responsibilities: Receive, store and issue stores under established procedures
Verify invoices against goods received notes
Post and maintain stores records and carry out stock-taking
requirements: Diploma in Stores/Supply Chain Management, Procurement or equivalent

title: Biomedical Technician
summary: Keep medical equipment inventoried, maintained and repaired, and train end users on it.
responsibilities: Carry out preventive maintenance and repairs
Conduct end-user training and routine servicing
Plan and budget for repairs
requirements: Diploma in Biomedical Technology from a recognised institution

title: Legal Officer
summary: Advise on legal matters, keep the Institute within the law, and review contracts and internal policies.
responsibilities: Advise on legal matters and ensure contracts are sound
Ensure statutory compliance (URSB, URA, NSSF, UIA)
Prepare legal opinions and staff training on labour law and ethics
requirements: LLB from a recognised university
Diploma in Legal Practice from the Law Development Centre

title: Assistant Engineering Officer
summary: Maintain and repair hospital facilities and equipment to keep the infrastructure safe and running.
responsibilities: Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions
Conduct safety inspections
Maintain accurate maintenance and repair records
requirements: Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution
Civil engineering experience is an advantage

title: Assistant Security Officer
summary: Support day-to-day security for patients, staff, property and assets, monitoring access and responding to incidents.
responsibilities: Run day-to-day security matters at the hospital
Ensure safety of hospital property, vehicles and estates
Prepare security reports and manage allocated resources
requirements: Diploma in any field from a recognised institution
Police or security-discipline training
At least 3 years with a reputable organisation as security personnel

title: Receptionist
summary: Be the first point of contact for patients and visitors, handling front-desk tasks and directing people to the right services.
responsibilities: Manage the front desk and reception area
Handle incoming and outgoing calls and keep call records
Welcome, register and direct patients and visitors
requirements: Uganda Certificate of Education (UCE) with at least a credit in English
Certificate in customer care, public relations or related training
